svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Python and Django Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Language Fundamentals: Modern Python and type hints, Classes and data classes, Errors and exceptions, Packages and environments, Code style and linting, Async Python; 02 The Framework: Projects and apps, URLs and views, Django REST Framework basics, Middleware and the request cycle, Settings and environments, The admin site; 03 HTTP and REST APIs: REST API design, Serializers, Views, viewsets and routers, Status codes and headers, Filtering and pagination, API documentation with OpenAPI; 04 Databases and Data Access: Models and migrations, Relationships and queries, Efficient queries, Data integrity and transactions, Factories and seed data, Raw SQL; 05 Validation and Error Handling: Validation with serializers, Error response format, Domain errors, Logging; 06 Authentication and Authorization: Password storage, API tokens, Cookie sign-in for single-page apps, Permission classes, Rate limiting sign-in; 07 Background Jobs and Caching: Tasks with Celery, Email, Scheduled tasks, Caching, Django's Tasks framework; 08 Testing: API tests with pytest, Test data and the database, Mocks and external services, Contract tests and type checks, Mutation testing; 09 Security and Performance: Django's security settings, CORS and security headers, The security audit checklist, Query performance and indexes, Load testing, Async views and ASGI; 10 Deployment and Operations: Production configuration, Docker images and application servers, CI/CD pipelines, Production database migrations, Workers in production, Health checks and monitoring
svg.text: Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
